component.name: BirdGame
component.script:
sub init() m.W = LumenTheme().gameW m.H = LumenTheme().gameH m.gap = 150 m.colW = 84 m.colH = 402 m.bw = 66 m.bh = 57
kitInit("bird") m.sky = m.top.createChild("Poster") ' The painting covers the stage at 16:9; show its sky band. m.sky.width = m.W m.sky.height = m.W * 9 / 16 m.sky.translation = [0, -150] m.scrim = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.scrim.width = m.W m.scrim.height = m.H kitStripAnim(m.top, "pkg:/images/games/town_night.png", 1400, 130, 172, 22)
' Pool of column pairs, reused as they leave the screen. m.cols = m.top.createChild("Group") m.pool = [] for i = 0 to 3 g = m.cols.createChild("Group") top = g.createChild("Poster") top.uri = "pkg:/images/games/column_down.png" top.width = m.colW top.height = m.colH bottom = g.createChild("Poster") bottom.uri = "pkg:/images/games/column_up.png" bottom.width = m.colW bottom.height = m.colH g.visible = false m.pool.Push({ g: g, top: top, bottom: bottom, x: 0.0, gapY: 0, used: false, passed: false }) end for kitStripAnim(m.top, "pkg:/images/games/hills_night.png", 1400, 80, 262, 70)
frames = ["pkg:/images/games/bird_0.png", "pkg:/images/games/bird_1.png", "pkg:/images/games/bird_2.png"] m.bird = kitSprite(m.top, frames, m.bw, m.bh) reset() end sub
sub onTheme() m.sky.uri = "pkg:/images/wall/wall_" + m.top.theme + ".jpg" end sub
sub onDeep() m.scrim.color = WithAlpha(m.top.deep, 0.2) end sub
sub reset() for each c in m.pool c.used = false c.g.visible = false end for m.x = 260 m.y = 130 m.vy = 0 m.speed = 170 m.nextCol = 230 m.anim = 1 m.bird.g.translation = [m.x, m.y] m.bird.g.rotation = 0 kitFrame(m.bird, 1) end sub
sub begin() flap() end sub
sub action(k as string) if k = "OK" then flap() end sub
sub flap() m.vy = -420 m.anim = 0 end sub
sub addColumn() for each c in m.pool if not c.used c.used = true c.passed = false c.x = m.W * 1.0 c.gapY = 50 + Rnd(m.H - 50 - 74 - m.gap) c.top.translation = [0, c.gapY - m.colH] c.bottom.translation = [0, c.gapY + m.gap] c.g.translation = [c.x, 0] c.g.visible = true return end if end for end sub
sub advance(dt as float) m.vy = m.vy + 1300 * dt if m.vy > 600 then m.vy = 600 m.y = m.y + m.vy * dt m.bird.g.translation = [m.x, m.y] r = -m.vy / 1000.0 if r < -0.7 then r = -0.7 if r > 0.4 then r = 0.4 m.bird.g.rotation = r ' Wings beat right after a flap, then glide. m.anim = m.anim + dt if m.anim < 0.3 then kitFrame(m.bird, Int(m.anim / 0.06) mod 3) else kitFrame(m.bird, 1)
m.speed = m.speed + 4 * dt if m.speed > 300 then m.speed = 300 m.nextCol = m.nextCol - m.speed * dt if m.nextCol <= 0 addColumn() m.nextCol = 300 end if
bx = m.x + 12 by = m.y + 10 bw = m.bw - 24 bh = m.bh - 18 hit = (m.y < -30) or (m.y + m.bh - 8 > 300) for each c in m.pool if c.used c.x = c.x - m.speed * dt c.g.translation = [c.x, 0] if not c.passed and c.x + m.colW < m.x c.passed = true m.top.points = m.top.points + 1 end if ' Cap (full width) near the gap, shaft (narrower) beyond it. if kitHit(bx, by, bw, bh, c.x + 2, c.gapY - 38, m.colW - 4, 38) then hit = true if kitHit(bx, by, bw, bh, c.x + 11, -500, m.colW - 22, c.gapY + 500) then hit = true if kitHit(bx, by, bw, bh, c.x + 2, c.gapY + m.gap, m.colW - 4, 38) then hit = true if kitHit(bx, by, bw, bh, c.x + 11, c.gapY + m.gap, m.colW - 22, 500) then hit = true if c.x + m.colW < -10 c.used = false c.g.visible = false end if end if end for if hit then kitOver() end sub
